name: Nanatsuki Shion
source:
Another one of the daughters in the Nanatsuki family. Shion is an introvert and lives on the top of the tower beside the main building. Or she’s only restricted to living there. Therefore she has never seen the outside world and doesn’t know quite a lot of things we consider common sense. Somewhat shy and softspoken. Loves singing.
